	Do Case
		Case GridSDTBudgetsPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			GridSDTBudgets.PreviousPage()
		Case GridSDTBudgetsPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			&PageToGo = GridSDTBudgets.CurrentPage
			&PageToGo += 1
			GridSDTBudgets.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridSDTBudgetsPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			GridSDTBudgets.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

if not (&BudgetYear.IsEmpty() and &ConsolidatedName.IsEmpty() and &ProductNumber.IsEmpty())
	
	&SDTBudget.Clear()
	For each
		Where CustomerStatus = 'A'
		Where ConsolidatedName = &ConsolidatedName
		
		&ItemSDTBudget = new()
		&ItemSDTBudget.ConsolidatedName = &ConsolidatedName
		&ItemSDTBudget.Customer = Customer
		&ItemSDTBudget.CustomerName = CustomerName
		&ItemSDTBudget.CustomerShipping = CustomerShipping 
		&ItemSDTBudget.ProductNumber = &ProductNumber
		&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetYear = &BudgetYear
		
		
		
		For &i = 1 to 12
			&Budget.Load(Produccion.Customer, &ProductNumber, &BudgetYear, &i)
			&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth = &i	
			
			Do Case
				Case &i = 1
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth1 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 2
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth2 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 3
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth3 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 4
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth4 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 5
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth5 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 6
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth6 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 7
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth7 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 8
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth8 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 9
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth9 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 10
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth10 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 11
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth11 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
				Case &i = 12
					&ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth12 =  &Budget.BudgetPrice
					
				Otherwise
					
			Endcase		
			
			
		Endfor
		&SDTBudget.Add(&ItemSDTBudget)
	endfor
else
msg('Please select filter')
endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

&i = 0 
	For &ItemSDTBudget in &SDTBudget
		&i = &i +1
		if(&i = 1)
			//Tomo Elemento a Copiar
			&CloneItemSDTBudget = &ItemSDTBudget.Clone()
		else
			
			
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth1 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth1
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth2 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth2
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth3 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth3
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth4 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth4
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth5 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth5
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth6 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth6

			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth8 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth8
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth9 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth9
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth10 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth10
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth11 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth11
			&SDTBudget.Item(&i).BudgetMonth12 = &CloneItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth12
		endif
	
		
	endfor
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

For &ItemSDTBudget in &SDTBudget
			For &i = 1 to 12
				
				&Budget.Load(&ItemSDTBudget.Customer, &ItemSDTBudget.ProductNumber, &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetYear, &i)
				Do Case
					Case &i = 1
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth1
					Case &i = 2
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth2
					Case &i = 3
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth3
					Case &i = 4
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth4
					Case &i = 5
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth5
					Case &i = 6
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth6
					Case &i = 7
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth7
					Case &i = 8
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth8
					Case &i = 9
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth9
					Case &i = 10

					Case &i = 11

					Case &i = 12
						&Budget.BudgetPrice = &ItemSDTBudget.BudgetMonth12
					
					Otherwise
						
				Endcase

				commit		
			endfor
			
	Endfor
